name: zone
title: Zone
description: Search your Zone for iPhone dictations, voice notes, meetings and clips on your Mac, paste the latest clip, and tick off open notes.
author: zaydiscold

preferences.name: zonePath
preferences.title: zone Path
preferences.description: Where the zone program is. Leave empty to look in ~/.local/bin, /usr/local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin and Zone.app.

preferences.name: libraryFolder
preferences.title: Library Folder
preferences.description: Read another zone library (zone's ZONE_HOME). Leave empty for the usual one.

commands.name: search-zone
commands.title: Search Zone
commands.description: Search your dictations, voice notes, meetings and clips, by day.

commands.name: open-notes
commands.title: Open Notes
commands.description: Your voice notes that are not done yet, to tick off.

commands.name: latest-clip
commands.title: Paste Latest Clip
commands.description: Paste, or copy, the newest text you sent from your iPhone.

preferences.name: clipAction
preferences.title: Action
preferences.description: What to do with the newest clip.

commands.name: recent-clips
commands.title: Recent Clips
commands.description: Text you sent from your iPhone to this Mac, newest first.

commands.name: meetings
commands.title: Search Meetings
commands.description: Your recorded meetings with their transcripts by speaker.

commands.name: zone-status
commands.title: Zone Status
commands.description: Whether zone is running, which phones are paired, the last sync and the counts.

tools.name: search-zone
tools.title: Search Zone
tools.description: Full-text search of the person's Zone library (dictations, voice notes, meetings, clips), newest first, with snippets and a cursor for more.

tools.name: list-zone-items
tools.title: List Zone Items
tools.description: List the person's Zone items in a time window, optionally only some kinds, as short cards newest or oldest first.

tools.name: get-zone-items
tools.title: Get Zone Items
tools.description: Get the full text of Zone items by id, for ids taken from search or list results.

tools.name: get-latest-clip
tools.title: Get Latest Clip
tools.description: Get the newest clip: text the person sent from their iPhone to this Mac on purpose, "the thing I just sent you".

tools.name: get-open-notes
tools.title: Get Open Notes
tools.description: Get the person's voice notes that are not marked done yet: their to-do list.

tools.name: get-latest-meeting
tools.title: Get Latest Meeting
tools.description: Get the most recent meeting with its title, time, speakers and full transcript.

tools.name: mark-notes-done
tools.title: Mark Notes Done
tools.description: Mark voice notes as done, or as not done again. It only sets the done flag and never changes any text.

tools.name: search-zone-mentions
tools.title: Zone Items
tools.description: Search Zone dictations, voice notes, meetings and clips to mention in AI Chat. Shows the newest items when the query is empty.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
